notes: 1-in/8-out 4K HDMI splitter/distribution amp. Bandwidth is stated as 600 MHz / 18 Gbps with HDCP 2.2 and 4K60 4:4:4 support (Gefen user manual spec table), which matches HDMI 2.0's max bandwidth exactly, so HDMI ports are graded hdmi-2.0. Exact rear-panel silkscreen text for the HDMI ports wasn't independently viewable (image-based diagram); conventional "HDMI In" / "HDMI Out 1-8" naming used, corroborated by manufacturer copy ("1x HDMI" in, "8x HDMI" out) and the user manual's per-model connection tables. Sibling model GTB-UHD600-28S-RT (2-input version) shares the same manual/family — do not confuse the two; 18S-RT has exactly 1 HDMI input. Desktop enclosure (4.49" W x 10.35" D x 0.984" H) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. USB control port is physically Mini-USB (not Micro-USB); mapped to the closest available connector id "usb-micro". Ethernet port's link speed is not published, so grade omitted per instructions. Sources: manufacturer page https://gefen.com/products/1x8-hdmi-splitter-for-4k-hdr-gtb-uhd600-18s-rt (and legacy https://gefen.com/product/4k-ultra-hd-18-splitter/), user manual via https://www.manualslib.com/manual/2607750/Gefen-Gtb-Uhd600-18s-Rt.html, retailer corroboration via https://www.kvmgalore.com/shopping/gefen-4k-ultra-hd-600-mhz-hdmi-splitter-8-ports-hdr-gtb-uhd600-18s-rt-p-52837.html.
